definitions.explanation: An on-site wastewater treatment system that processes household sewage before discharging it. Common in areas of Japan not connected to the public sewage system. Regulated under the Septic Tank Law ({浄化槽法|じょうかそうほう}).

examples.japanese: {浄化槽|じょうかそう}の{点検|てんけん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had the septic tank inspected.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{下水道|げすいどう}がないため、{浄化槽|じょうかそう}を{設置|せっち}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Since this area has no sewage system, a septic tank needs to be installed.

examples.japanese: {浄化槽|じょうかそう}は{定期的|ていきてき}に{清掃|せいそう}しないと、{悪臭|あくしゅう}の{原因|げんいん}になる。
examples.english: If the septic tank isn't cleaned regularly, it can cause bad odors.

notes:
A compound of {浄化|じょうか} (purification) + {槽|そう} (tank, vat). In Japan, areas without municipal sewage infrastructure use {浄化槽|じょうかそう} to treat household wastewater on-site. Homeowners with a {浄化槽|じょうかそう} are legally required to have it inspected and cleaned regularly.

There are two types:
- {単独|たんどく}{浄化槽|じょうかそう}: treats only toilet waste (older type)
- {合併|がっぺい}{浄化槽|じょうかそう}: treats all household wastewater including kitchen and bath (modern standard)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}を{設置|せっち}する: to install a septic tank
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}の{清掃|せいそう}: septic tank cleaning
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}の{点検|てんけん}: septic tank inspection
- {浄化槽|じょうかそう}{管理|かんり}: septic tank maintenance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下水道|げすいどう}: sewage system — public municipal sewage infrastructure
- {汚水|おすい}{処理|しょり}: sewage treatment — the general process, not the specific equipment
